text:
Asha Patel: Quick weekly note — anchoring this week on Q2 launch readiness. Focus areas: Dedicated GA polish, extend Private beta to pilots, and shave more cost from hosted. Please read and react.

Asha Patel: TL;DR: two launches on the critical path, one operational incident with a fix in flight, and a couple of org-level asks (dashboards + pricing slide).

Ravi Singh: Incident recap — Wed night GPU OOM cascade tied to the allocator race when scaling from 0->n. Patch landed in staging, rollback path validated. Postmortem draft in #eng-oncall, will link after review.

Diego Morales: Noted. I'll add a temporary throttle for long-seq jobs in staging and run an extended load test Thurs. Also pushing an allocator lock to runtime-canary.

Maya Chen: Product update — Dedicated GA docs are ready except for one compliance note on audit logs. Private beta invites: 3 pilots lined up, we need opt-in emails finalized.

Samir Patel: Finance check — aiming for $0.0095 / 1K tokens baseline for hosted by end of week. If autoscale instability persists, we should hold off on public pricing commitments.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime v2.14 -> 12% traffic at 17:04 UTC. Health checks green so far, will report at +30m.

Asha Patel: Action items (short):
1) Ravi — confirm full rollout of the allocator patch by EOD and paste the postmortem link.
2) Diego — share load-test results and the autoscale policy tweak in #eng-runtime.
3) Maya — finalize pilot invite text & send by 15:00 PST.
4) Samir — update pricing slide deck if targets drift.

Diego Morales: Will do. I expect the load test report by 11:30 PT and I'll tag the rollout PR.

Maya Chen: Sending invites at 13:00 PT, will attach the pilot checklist and data collection plan.

Asha Patel: One small org ask: pin the customer-facing latency & cost widgets in the Console for the GA rollout so PMs can reference live numbers. :rocket:

Asha Patel: Thanks team — keep flags here and escalate early if anything slips.
